FFmpeg version: 8.1.2
Targets: arm64-apple-macosx14.0 and x86_64-apple-macosx14.0 (Universal 2)
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
SHA-256: 464beb5e7bf0c311e68b45ae2f04e9cc2af88851abb4082231742a74d97b524c

The reproducible configure options are maintained in scripts/build_ffmpeg_macos.sh.
This build deliberately disables GPL, nonfree, network access, device input,
automatic external-library detection, and unrelated codecs/formats. It enables
only the local file/pipe protocols and the Matroska, SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT and
PGS and VobSub components needed for inspection, subtitle extraction, local
bitmap decoding and stream-copy muxing.
